gloss: to tease, to make fun of; to window-shop

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {冷|ひ}やかしていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to tease, to make fun of, to jeer at
definitions.explanation: To mock or ridicule someone in a playful or slightly malicious way, often by making comments about their behavior or situation.

definitions.gloss: to window-shop, to browse without buying
definitions.explanation: To look at goods in a shop or stall without intending to purchase anything.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{冷|ひ}やかした。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦デート→デート：03861_deeto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}ったら→言う：00515_iu⟧、⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{冷|ひ}やかされた。
examples.english: When he said he was going on a date, everyone teased him.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新人|しんじん}→新人：02500_shinjin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{冷|ひ}やかす⟦の→の：09472_no⟧はやめ⟦なさい→なさる：01307_nasaru⟧。
examples.english: Stop making fun of the newcomer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{冷|ひ}やかして⟦{歩|ある}いた→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。

⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦つもり→つもり：01152_tsumori⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{骨董品|こっとうひん}→骨董品：06990_kottouhin⟧⟦{店|てん}→店：10011_ten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{冷|ひ}やかし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I had no intention of buying, but went to browse the antique shop.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祭|まつ}り→祭り：03735_matsuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{屋台|やたい}→屋台：10549_yatai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{冷|ひ}やかし⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{楽|たの}しく→楽しい：00817_tanoshii⟧⟦{過|す}ごした→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧。
examples.english: I had a good time with a friend browsing the festival stalls.

notes:
Originally related to ⟦{冷|ひ}やす→冷やす：02403_hiyasu⟧ (to cool), but the modern meanings have diverged.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: transitive (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧)
- Pattern: A⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧B⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{冷|ひ}やかす (A teases B / A browses B)

ASPECT (ている):
- {冷|ひ}やかして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ = is teasing / is browsing (ongoing action)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{冷|ひ}やかす (to tease someone)
- ⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{冷|ひ}やかす (to browse a shop)
- {冷|ひ}やかされる (to be teased — passive)
- {冷|ひ}やかし⟦{半分|はんぶん}→半分：02938_hanbun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (half-jokingly)

USAGE:
The teasing sense (sense 1) is the more common usage today. The window-shopping sense (sense 2) is somewhat old-fashioned but still understood. The noun form ⟦{冷|ひ}やかし→冷やかし：30480_hiyakashi⟧ refers to either the act of teasing or of browsing without buying.
